description:
Title: Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks

When building a custom machine out of Lego bricks, you first need to develop the basic design.
After that, you order certain Lego brick sets.
You give the lego sets to a group of children which should sort the parts for you (into a number of containers).
Your machine is built out of a number of subcomponents.
You build them individually, using parts from the sorted containers.
If there are no more parts in a container, you reorder individual parts.
After building each subcomponent, you have to test them individually and (if each test is successful) assemble them.
If subcomponents are not tested successfully, you have to redesign and rebuild them.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_LegoMachine" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/lego-machine">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_LegoMachine" name="Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Begin" name="Start building custom machine">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Begin_Design</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DevelopDesign" name="Develop basic design">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Begin_Design</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Design_Order</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSets" name="Order Lego brick sets">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Design_Order</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Order_Sort</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SortParts" name="Children sort parts into containers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Order_Sort</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Sort_PartsCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsCheck_Split" name="Container has parts?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Sort_PartsCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PartsCheck_HasParts</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PartsCheck_Empty</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderParts" name="Reorder individual parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PartsCheck_Empty</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reorder_PartsReady</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsReady_Merge" name="Parts ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PartsCheck_HasParts</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Reorder_PartsReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PartsReady_Build</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildSubcomponent" name="Build subcomponent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PartsReady_Build</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Rework_Build</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Build_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSubcomponent" name="Test subcomponent individually">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Build_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Result</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestResult_Split" name="All tests successful?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_Result</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Result_Assemble</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Result_Redesign</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleSubcomponent" name="Assemble subcomponents">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Result_Assemble</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Assemble_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Assembled" name="Machine assembled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Assemble_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RedesignRebuildSubcomponent" name="Redesign and rebuild subcomponent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Result_Redesign</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Rework_Build</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Begin_Design" sourceRef="StartEvent_Begin" targetRef="Task_DevelopDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Design_Order" sourceRef="Task_DevelopDesign" targetRef="Task_OrderSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_Sort" sourceRef="Task_OrderSets" targetRef="Task_SortParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sort_PartsCheck" sourceRef="Task_SortParts" targetRef="Gateway_PartsCheck_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PartsCheck_HasParts" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsCheck_Split" targetRef="Gateway_PartsReady_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PartsCheck_Empty" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsCheck_Split" targetRef="Task_ReorderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reorder_PartsReady" sourceRef="Task_ReorderParts" targetRef="Gateway_PartsReady_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PartsReady_Build" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsReady_Merge" targetRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_Test" sourceRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent" targetRef="Task_TestSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Result" sourceRef="Task_TestSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_TestResult_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Result_Assemble" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult_Split" targetRef="Task_AssembleSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Result_Redesign" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult_Split" targetRef="Task_RedesignRebuildSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assemble_End" sourceRef="Task_AssembleSubcomponent" targetRef="EndEvent_Assembled"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rework_Build" sourceRef="Task_RedesignRebuildSubcomponent" targetRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
